prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for sideswipe collision during lane change. Insured reports other vehicle merged into their lane on the highway and contact occurred at the rear quarter panel. Police report requested. Liability appears disputed at this stage.

Entry 2: Spoke with insured. Insured states they signaled and checked mirrors before moving over. Dashcam footage reportedly exists and has been requested from the insured. Photos of vehicle damage uploaded to file.

Entry 3: Claimant contacted our office through legal counsel. Claimant is represented and all further communication must go through the attorney's office. Claimant reports a knee injury and is seeking medical treatment. Requested medical authorization and records through counsel.

Entry 4: Reviewed scene diagram and witness statement from a passenger in the insured vehicle. Witness corroborates insured's account of signaling. Independent witness contact still outstanding. Reserve adjusted to reflect pending bodily injury evaluation.

Entry 5: Received correspondence from claimant's attorney requesting policy limits information and a settlement demand timeline. Forwarded to supervisor for review. Diary set to follow up on medical records and independent witness in fourteen days.
